notes: Test set for the Canada capability card (Québec lithium study economics). The first question is the card's exact prompt.

questions.q: Compare the study economics of Québec's lithium projects (after-tax NPV, initial capex, IRR and mine life) and show them on a map.
questions.judge: Builds a comparison from the stored study figures for the Québec lithium projects (Shaakichiuwaanaan, Whabouchi, Rose, Moblan, James Bay/Galaxy, North American Lithium; PAK and Georgia Lake are in Ontario and must not be counted as Québec), with each figure's currency (C$), discount rate and study name/date, noting where a figure is missing (e.g. Rose and Moblan have no initial-capex fact; Moblan gives total capex) and that the studies differ in date and type (PFS vs FS), so they are not directly comparable. Shows a map of the projects. Must not invent figures.

questions.q: How do the Athabasca uranium development projects compare on study economics?
questions.judge: Compares Wheeler River (Phoenix ISR, Denison), Arrow / Rook I (NexGen) and PLS (Paladin, formerly Fission) from stored facts: post-tax NPV8, IRR, initial capex in C$ with study dates, noting the different studies and dates. Must not invent figures or present US$ for C$ values.
